scope.focus: Textual fidelity and selected-probe relations, not factual truth, legality, full extraction or model accuracy.

summary.mutation_field_integrity: All 16 mutations change exactly the single declared field; all 16 baselines equal their diagnostic oracle.
summary.literal_span_integrity: All 46 candidate claim spans match exact source substrings in Python Unicode code points.
summary.semantic_mutation_summary: 15 mutations add a clear wrong semantic relation/value under the stated role conventions; R015 requires an explicit composition policy. R027 and R031 inherit baseline uncertainty and must not be advertised as uniquely one total semantic defect.

issues.certainty: Definite absence of textual support for same-vehicle identity; whether vehicle_1 encodes identity rather than a nonsemantic placeholder requires a convention.

evidence.quote: Сегодня на той же парковке я не оплатил новую стоянку

issues.reasoning: Той же парковке explicitly links the facility. Новую стоянку plus yesterday/today explicitly separates stays. No vehicle is mentioned, and the shared facility does not establish one shared vehicle. Reusing a real entity ID across both claims adds an unsupported identity. This is a chosen subject relation, not an objection to omitted eventTime or an exhaustive-extraction requirement.
issues.proposed_resolution: Define anonymous target IDs as nonsemantic episode-local placeholders with identity excluded from evaluation, or assign unresolved/episode-specific targets, or explicitly add same-car wording in a new dataset version. Until then, R028 is indeterminate under ordinary entity-ID semantics. Keep R027 incompatible for its independently wrong episode merge; it inherits the baseline issue.
issues.gate_effect: Resolve before treating the baseline as a uniquely compatible semantic reference.

issues.certainty: Genuine underspecification of diagnostic-field composition; not a proven polarity mistake.

evidence.quote: Я не утверждал, что оплатил парковку

issues.reasoning: The predicate changes speechAct→payment, but the candidate retains the speech-act mode and assertion-of-payment scope. A compositional reading can still denote denial of an assertion about payment, just as payment+obligation denotes an obligation rather than completed payment in C009. If predicate names the outer claim kind, this is a wrong-kind defect; if mode/scope supply the operator, it can be a faithful alternative encoding. The supplied artifacts do not define that precedence. One changed field is established; exactly one semantic defect is not.
issues.proposed_resolution: Declare predicate as the outermost claim kind and specify the scope/precedence of stance and mode, or replace this mutation with speechAct stance denied→asserted, which clearly contradicts the denied speech act. Keep the baseline R016 compatible.
issues.gate_effect: Resolve before scoring R015 as semantic incompatibility.

issues.certainty: The personal-versus-existential distinction is definite; a current numerical/label error depends on the intended projection semantics.

evidence.quote: Парковку моего автомобиля оплатил друг, а не я

issues.reasoning: A named person did not pay is not equivalent to no payment for the parking stay by anyone. C012 directly demonstrates why those propositions differ. The diagnostic oracle preserves actor in C002 and C013, whereas the fragment slice has no typed actor/scope and C014 already leaves actor null. The existing selected-field counts are mechanically reproducible and are expressly not full-meaning counts: omission of an out-of-scope actor is not automatically a dataset defect. The counts overclaim only if representable payment=denied is later interpreted as a complete vehicle-level nonpayment fact, rather than stance over the quoted person-scoped proposition.
issues.proposed_resolution: State whether payment stance is attached to the exact quoted, actor-scoped proposition or to existential payment status of the stay. For the former, explicitly exclude actor identity and all-payer payment status from the representability claim. For the latter, add typed actor/scope dependencies to the selected probes and recompute. Do not automatically relabel all first-person cases because their baselines are intentionally selected probes.
issues.gate_effect: A necessary semantic policy before using the narrow representability table as a fact-preservation claim; not an unconditional arithmetic failure.

issues.certainty: Definite mismatch between the breadth of the wording and the parking-specific predicate definition; the existing indeterminate label is defensible.
issues.reasoning: Standing in an unidentified zone is explicit. The frozen placement definition is specifically being on parking, so asserting that selected predicate also depends on interpreting ПП as some parking zone. Ambiguity is therefore not merely an unselected paidRegime/cityParking detail. The negative-payment claim and its document source are independently clear at the textual-assertion level, though no record-level absence is specified.
issues.proposed_resolution: Keep R032 indeterminate for the selected placement claim and localize the reason. Retain payment denied as the document’s selected negative claim. Do not infer paidRegime or cityParking. R031 adds a clear wrong payment polarity even though the placement baseline remains unresolved.
issues.gate_effect: Clarification; do not convert the whole record to compatible without resolving or dropping the placement probe.

issues.certainty: Conservative labeling choice, not a definite error.

evidence.quote: Я не мог не оплатить парковку

issues.reasoning: The usual idiom strongly conveys completed payment, while the explicit modal content is inability to avoid payment. The supplied baseline mode=necessity preserves that shared modal content and does not explicitly encode completion. Thus source-level alternatives need not make this selected modal probe incompatible or uniquely undecidable. The existing indeterminate label is a defensible conservative policy, but the audit derives it solely from a nonempty case-level alternativeReadings list.
issues.proposed_resolution: Record whether compatibility means support of the selected modalized claim or uniqueness of the whole source interpretation. Retain indeterminate conservatively until the policy is settled. The mutation to a letter claimant is wrong under either reading.
issues.gate_effect: Policy clarification; no basis to collapse the source into plain actual positive or negative payment.

representability_review.assessment: The 7/7/2 sentence and 9/5/2 claim counts match the hand-declared requiredTypedFields and case-level ambiguity rules. Those are valid bookkeeping counts for that declared selection, not evidence of semantic completeness. Do not upgrade them to full narrative/claim preservation. Entity-ID semantics (C014), actor-scoped denial (C002/C013/C014), and predicate/mode/scope composition (C008) must be explicit before broader claims or model scoring.

recommended_gate.retain_as: Synthetic diagnostic development material with candidate labels and explicit ambiguity, no holdout or accuracy claim.
recommended_gate.next_step: The integration owner should adjudicate these conventions, revise affected selected probes/labels in a new dataset version, then rerun offline integrity and targeted semantic review.
